profile.tech_transfer: Cambridge Enterprise (incl. Cambridge Enterprise Ventures); MRC LMB spinouts handled by LGC for the MRC
profile.summary: Cambridge and the neighbouring MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology seeded several of the UK's defining biotechs, from phage-display antibodies (CAT, Humira) to Solexa sequencing, fragment-based drug discovery (Astex) and the PARP inhibitor olaparib (KuDOS). It remains one of Europe's most prolific spinout generators, forming 20 new companies in FY2024-25 and holding a 196-company cash-and-equity portfolio.
programs: Founders at the University of Cambridge (SYNC, SPARK, START)
Cambridge Innovation Capital (£100m commitment to university spinouts)
